final_draft.answer: No. A read-only check of our production AWS account (111122223333) on 2026-11-18 found that new EBS disks are not encrypted by default in the us-east-1 region.
final_draft.note: Please review before sending. The approved answer (answer:89bda81e-304b-49f2-a828-289b50c26d12, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18) says 'Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.' A live check at 2026-11-18T03:48:35Z contradicts it: default EBS encryption is off in us-east-1. So I did not reuse the approved 'Yes'. The check only looked at us-east-1, so it says nothing about other regions. That 111122223333 is the production account comes from the approved root-MFA answer (answer:37be032e-1a16-4f11-9ca6-08546ee57a8e). The answer owner should decide two things: whether to turn on default EBS encryption before replying, and whether the approved answer needs to be corrected or withdrawn.
